title: The Vault's Stone
journal: The second seal-stone lies in the lowest hall of the Vaults of Gemin, which is under water. The dead walk the vaults and a wraith guards the last hall, and Unbound may be searching there. I'm to go down and take it. I can fight through, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin. (marker: Seal-Stone of the Kings, Gemin)
Read the Tablet of the Kings beside the stone. (marker: Tablet of the Kings)

plan.going: I am hunting the three seal-stones for the Toh-Reel-Ka; this one is in Gemin's drowned lowest hall
plan.next: go down through the vaults to the lowest hall and take the stone; read the tablet beside it
plan.ways: fight the Unbound, the dead and the wraith; slip past them (Sneak); turn the dead and the wraith (Restoration); I must swim the last hall, or carry waterbreathing

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Reel-Ka under Never-Writes-Twice. I am collecting three Seal-Stones of the Kings, which open a gate at the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth leading to the Eye at the Root. I already have the first stone. Now I am at the Vaults of Gemin for the second. The Unbound may be searching here, and the Collector Ennodius Vanin is a rival after the same relics.
Go down into the drowned lowest hall of Gemin, take the Seal-Stone of the Kings, and read the Tablet of the Kings beside it.
I can fight through the Unbound and the dead, sneak past them (my preferred way), or turn the dead with Restoration. A wraith guards the last hall.
I do not understand why the Unbound drain seal trees, what the Eye at the Root really is, or what the Tablet will say. I may learn from the tablet and from talking to the Warden of the Vaults.

title: The Vault's Stone
journal: I took the second seal-stone from the drowned hall of Gemin. The tablet beside it says that the Eye, lifted, parts every tree from every other, and used where it sits, it strengthens them. I already carry the thief's stone from Blackrose. One is left, in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and it is still marked.

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka. I now hold two of three seal-stones. The tablet says the Eye, if lifted, parts every tree from every other, but used where it sits it strengthens them.
Go to the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (boat near Noota Nara) for the third stone, then to the Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.
I can sneak or fight at Vorannuhl; then decide whether to lift the Eye (which parts the trees) or use it in place (which strengthens them).
I do not understand why the Unbound drain trees, what happens to the Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound. I do not know how I would find out yet.
